message.content:
A medium‑sized apple (about 182 g) contains roughly **95 kcal**.  
- Small apple (~149 g): ~77 kcal  
- Large apple (~223 g): ~116 kcal  

So you can expect an apple to be in the **80–120 kcal** range, depending on its size and variety.
